title: TopologyOverlayBase
description: Topology artifact binding snapshot used to guard overlay patches against the base graph they were compiled for.

source.description: Service that owns topology view resolution.

viewId.description: Topology v2 view identifier the overlay applies to.

scope.description: Topology v2 scope the overlay applies to.

params.description: View-specific topology params used for the base graph.

limits.description: Resolve limits used for the base graph.

timeMode.description: Whether the overlay applies to a fixed or current topology artifact.
